_comment: Hologram models (VECTOR's format: vector's tools/holo/collection.py and assets/holo/README.md). Boxes are [x0,x1, y0,y1, z0,z1] in fractions of the normalised bounding box (y up, front +z); a face goes to the first part whose box holds its centroid, else to the part with rest=true. bind names the live reading a part shows (VECTOR's holo/bind.py), empty for a part that only shapes the model. Sources are in src/; the baked NAME.holo.npz sit next to this file. Rebake: ~/.local/share/bromigos/venv/bin/python <vector>/tools/holo/bake.py --root THIS_DIR --preview

parts.label: RELAY
parts.hint: The relay among the crystals: when it transmits, the formations resonate and the miners say the caves sing back. Lit while every channel on the network answers

parts.label: LIFT HEAD
parts.hint: The lift head miles above, the only way down. The flame is carved into the stone where the cage lands

parts.label: GREAT CRYSTAL
parts.hint: Taller than the lift towers: Ora Slate keeps the network's deep archive in the singing crystals, and has never described how

parts.label: SINGING CRYSTALS
parts.hint: Amethyst lit from inside, ringing when anything moves; teal when a crystal answers a note

parts.label: CAVERN FLOOR
parts.hint: The cavern floor, miles down. Cave crabs with glowing shells crawl the walls, and miners follow them when the lamps fail
